basic_details.job_title: FACT Diesel Mechanic Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited (FACT), a Schedule 'A' multi-divisional Central PSE, is empanelling apprentices who completed apprenticeship training at the FACT Training & Development Centre on or before 31.12.2025 for engagement as Diesel Mechanic on Fixed Tenure Contract (Adhoc Basis), at a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,000 per month for a two-year term. Candidates need SSLC pass with a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in Mechanic (Diesel). The online form on www.fact.co.in closes on 30.11.2026, and the hard copy must reach by 07.12.2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is less than 35 years and above 18 years as on 01.09.2026. For later engagements from the panel, candidates must meet the maximum age limit as on the date of engagement. Relaxation in the maximum age limit is permissible up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC-NCL candidates. Only the Std X certificate having the date of birth is accepted as proof of date of birth.

how_to_apply: Go to www.fact.co.in >> Careers >> Job Openings >> Recruitment Notification and click the Online Application link.
Fill in all necessary data in the Online Form. The data must be the same as in the prescribed Application Form that is uploaded.
Upload the documents listed below in PDF format in the places provided in the Online Form.
Click the Submit button. The last date for submission of the Online Form is 30.11.2026.

Send the printout of the uploaded Application Form in original, with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents and the original certificates, by Speed Post / Registered Post to AGM (HR) Est, HR Department, FEDO Building, FACT, Udyogamandal, PIN – 683 501, so as to reach on or before 07.12.2026.
Write "Application for the post of Diesel Mechanic on FTCAB – Notification No. 09/2026" on the envelope.

Applications received by any mode other than online will be rejected. An application once submitted is final and no changes will be allowed. Online Forms submitted without the essential documents, or with an Application Form that is not duly filled up, are liable to be rejected.
Application Form in the prescribed format (the "Application Form" on the website along with the notification), manually filled, signed and with photo affixed
Apprenticeship Training Certificate issued by FACT T&D Centre
Caste / EWS / Disability Certificate, if reservation or relaxation is claimed
important_instructions: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC-NCL and EWS candidates applies as per Government Directives. EWS candidates must submit an EWS certificate of the relevant year (income of FY 2025-26 for engagement during FY 2026-27). OBC-NCL candidates must submit a self-declaration, in the prescribed format on the website, with the application. If engaged, they must produce an OBC-NCL certificate from the Competent Authority issued within 6 months prior to joining. Provisionally selected candidates must undergo a pre-employment medical examination and be certified fit by the Company's Medical Officer. No relaxation in physical or medical standards is allowed, and the Medical Officer's opinion is final. The PEME procedure is at www.fact.co.in >> HR >> Policy >> PEME. Engagement is also subject to the candidate staying medically fit during the contract and to submission of a Police Clearance Certificate. Further notifications and corrigenda will appear only on the company website under Careers. Individual communication goes only to the e-mail id given in the application form, which must stay valid and functional. Applications of candidates not included in the Panel are retained for no more than one year from the date of publication of the Panel. Documents related to this selection are preserved for two years from that date. Any dispute is to be settled in courts within the jurisdiction of Ernakulam, Kerala State only.

content_sections.heading: About FACT
content_sections.text: The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited describes itself as a multi-divisional Central PSE and a pioneer in the manufacture of Fertilisers, Chemicals and Caprolactam, with activities spread over Manufacturing, Engineering Design and Consultancy, Fabrication and more. The notice is issued by its HR Department at Udyogamandal and signed by the Assistant General Manager (HR).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only candidates who successfully completed Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act from the FACT Training & Development Centre on or before 31.12.2025 can apply. The notice says the purpose is empanelling candidates to be considered for engagement. The age limit is less than 35 years and above 18 years as on 01.09.2026. For later engagements from the panel, candidates must meet the maximum age limit as on the date of engagement. Relaxation in the maximum age limit is permissible up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC-NCL candidates. Only the Std X certificate having the date of birth is accepted as proof of date of birth. Apprentices who have completed or are completing apprenticeship in 2026 need not apply. The notice says they will be considered for engagement against requirements, if any, from a list sourced directly from the FACT Training & Development Centre. Only candidates who upload both the National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) and the certificate issued by the FACT Training & Development Centre with the online form will be considered for inclusion in the Panel. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

rows.post: Diesel Mechanic on Fixed Tenure Contract (Adhoc Basis)
rows.essential_qualification: SSLC pass with National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the trade of Mechanic (Diesel) and successfully completed apprenticeship training from FACT Training & Development Centre in the respective trade

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Engaged candidates will be paid a consolidated pay of Rs. 25,000/- per month, with an increase of 3% of the consolidated pay on successful completion of each year. Leave, ESI, Provident Fund, Shift allowance, and TA and DA for duty travel apply based on eligibility, as per the Rules of the Company. The engagement is for two years, renewable for a maximum of 2 spells of one year each, at the discretion of the Management, subject to requirement, performance and assessment. The Management may terminate the engagement with 15 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice, at its discretion and without assigning any reason. Engagement is for a fixed term only and gives no right to extension, permanent appointment or preferential treatment in appointment in the Company. Candidates from the panel may also be considered for engagement for shorter periods, at rates and terms fixed by the Company for such engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for FACT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.fact.co.in >> Careers >> Job Openings >> Recruitment Notification and click the Online Application link. Fill in all necessary data in the Online Form. The data must be the same as in the prescribed Application Form that is uploaded. Upload the documents listed below in PDF format in the places provided in the Online Form. Click the Submit button. The last date for submission of the Online Form is 30.11.2026. Send the printout of the uploaded Application Form in original, with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents and the original certificates, by Speed Post / Registered Post to AGM (HR) Est, HR Department, FEDO Building, FACT, Udyogamandal, PIN – 683 501, so as to reach on or before 07.12.2026. Write "Application for the post of Diesel Mechanic on FTCAB – Notification No. 09/2026" on the envelope. Applications received by any mode other than online will be rejected. An application once submitted is final and no changes will be allowed. Online Forms submitted without the essential documents, or with an Application Form that is not duly filled up, are liable to be rejected. Application Form in the prescribed format (the "Application Form" on the website along with the notification), manually filled, signed and with photo affixed Standard X Certificate National Trade Certificate (NTC) pass certificate National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) Apprenticeship Training Certificate issued by FACT T&D Centre Caste / EWS / Disability Certificate, if reservation or relaxation is claimed Self-declaration by OBC-NCL candidates

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After preliminary scrutiny of the documents submitted with the application, candidates are ranked in the following order: earlier date of passing Apprenticeship Training, then the order of Apprenticeship Token Number. Eligibility and selection are determined from the information and documents the candidate submits, and candidature is provisional at all stages. Meeting the eligibility criteria or inclusion in the Panel does not by itself give any right to selection or engagement. Engagement from the panels is at the sole discretion of the Management, subject to requirements and reservation rules. No TA/DA is paid to candidates for attending the selection process.

faq.answer: The last date for submission of the Online Form is 30.11.2026. The original Application Form with certificates must reach AGM (HR) Est by 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for FACT Diesel Mechanic?
faq.answer: SSLC pass with National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the trade of Mechanic (Diesel), and successfully completed apprenticeship training from FACT Training & Development Centre in the respective trade.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
